description: Live wait times at North Carolina DMV offices, published by NCDMV itself and refreshed continuously: the current average wait in minutes, the longest wait anyone in line is seeing, and whether each office is open right now. Covers all 148 NCDMV driver license offices statewide plus the vehicle services and license plate agency units, so it answers "how long is the wait at the Raleigh DMV", "is the Charlotte DMV open right now", "which DMV near Greensboro has the shortest line", or "shortest DMV wait in North Carolina today". North Carolina is one of only two states whose DMV publishes a live queue feed. Outside posted business hours the agency reports every office closed with a zero wait, which is an idle queue rather than a measurement, and the response says so.

open_only.description: When true, keep only offices the feed currently reports as open.

service.description: "driver" for driver license offices (default, 148 offices) or "vehicle" for vehicle services / license plate agency units.

sort.description: "wait" ranks shortest average wait first (open offices first); "name" (default) keeps the agency's own order.
